id.description: Unique identifier for the finding (e.g. DISC-001, ENG-001)

category.description: High-level domain category of the finding

subcategory.description: Fine-grained audit subcategory (e.g. structured_data, crawlability, orientation, navigation)

title.description: Clear and concise title describing the discovered issue

evidence.description: Specific observable evidence proving the finding. Must never be empty or hallucinated.

why_it_matters.description: Explanation of the mechanism and impact on AI discovery or user engagement

priority.description: Priority score for addressing the recommendation

confidence.description: Optional confidence score based on directness of evidence

affected_pages.description: Optional list of URLs where the issue was observed

evidence_type.description: Optional type of evidence (e.g. DOM, HTTP_HEADER, ROBOTS_TXT, SCHEMA_ORG)

methodology.description: Optional methodology stage (e.g. Reach, Read, Extract, Understand, Identify, Trust)
